name: Ahrefs
label: Ahrefs — SEO research (API v3)
description: Official Ahrefs API v3 at https://api.ahrefs.com (docs.ahrefs.com OpenAPI 3.0.0). Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer api_token. v2 is fully deprecated. Site Explorer overview is GET /v3/site-explorer/metrics (no /overview path). Backlinks are GET /v3/site-explorer/all-backlinks. Batch Analysis is POST /v3/batch-analysis/batch-analysis. Paid Lite+ plans consume API units (minimum 50 per billable request). Contract limits redistribution of SERP data. Customer owns the Ahrefs workspace. api_token is never logged. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: target
schema.description: Domain, URL, or prefix as the endpoint documents. Example: example.com.

schema.label: date
schema.description: YYYY-MM-DD report date; required by siteExplorer.overview (/site-explorer/metrics) and rankTracker.overview (/rank-tracker/overview). Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: mode
schema.description: Target mode: domain | prefix | exact.

schema.label: protocol
schema.description: Site Explorer protocol: both | http | https.

schema.label: select
schema.description: Comma-separated columns. Required by several Site Explorer / Keywords Explorer ops.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Row limit. Example: 100.

schema.label: where
schema.description: Per-operation field `where`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: order_by
schema.description: Per-operation field `order_by`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: output
schema.description: Per-operation field `output`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: keywords
schema.description: Keyword or list for Keywords Explorer overview.

schema.label: keyword
schema.description: SERP query.

schema.label: country
schema.description: Per-operation field `country`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Rank Tracker project id.

schema.label: device
schema.description: Ranking device for rankTracker.overview (required there). EXACT: desktop | mobile. Example: desktop.

schema.label: targets
schema.description: Up to 100 targets for batchAnalysis.

schema.label: volume_mode
schema.description: Query-string/request-body parameter `volume_mode` for operations: siteExplorer.overview, batchAnalysis.

schema.label: traffic_mode
schema.description: Query-string parameter `traffic_mode` for operation: siteExplorer.overview.

schema.label: top_countries
schema.description: Request-body parameter `top_countries` for operation: batchAnalysis.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: siteExplorer.overview | siteExplorer.backlinks | keywordsExplorer.overview | rankTracker.overview | serpOverview | batchAnalysis.

configurationParameters.label: Api Token
configurationParameters.description: Ahrefs v3 API token. Bearer. Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
